title: Lead Data Scientist
education: Master's or Bachelor's in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or Quantitative field
description: We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist with 5+ years of experience developing predictive statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and data pipelines.
